feed.title: Verilay Patchmap: Desktop and apps
feed.subtitle: Known problems and monthly security updates for Windows, from Verilay Patchmap. Not affiliated with Microsoft.

entry.title: Now fixed: USB audio devices might fail to start or produce no sound
entry.summary: Started with KB5124008. Fixed in KB5132061. Affects: Windows 11 24H2, Windows 11 25H2, Windows 11 26H2, Windows Server 2022, Windows Server 2025, Windows Server 2019, Windows Server 2016. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/release-health/status-windows-11-24h2#4984msgdesc. From Microsoft release health.
